subject: [hw] IP -> IV: one small accessor request: numeric stop code (protocol detail field)
body:
vcodecd has to put the n2a32 stop reason into the frozen protocol reply (N2VCD_E_GUEST.detail = enum n2a32_stop). host/n2vhost.h only exposes n2vhost_stop_text(); I currently map the first word of the text ("UNDEF", "FAULT", "NOIMPORT", ...) back to the enum. It works with your current strings and the real test sees detail 2 for UNDEF, but it is a text dependency in a binary protocol.

Could you add, next to n2vhost_stop_text():

  enum n2a32_stop n2vhost_stop_reason(const struct n2vhost *h);   /* N2A32_STOP_NONE while running */

(or the name you prefer)? I will switch one function in daemon/vcodecd.c and drop the text mapping. Not a blocker - my suite is green - just the clean interface. If you would rather keep the header as is, say so and I will leave the mapping documented in STATUS.
